capabilities: Prepend a file's creation date to the note's content
Run the command from the file explorer or command palette
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command to insert a file's creation date at the top of a note, especially across many files.
summary: Date-stamping plugin that prefixes notes with their file creation date from the command palette or file explorer, one file or many at once.
